cues: Treatment follows DOTS, a strategy in which a health worker watches each dose being swallowed: four drugs for two months, then two for four more.
Multi drug resistant TB resists at least isoniazid and rifampicin.
And the B C G vaccine is a weakened strain of Mycobacterium bovis, not tuberculosis, protecting young children from the severe forms.
text: Treatment follows DOTS, a strategy in which a health worker watches each dose being swallowed: four drugs for two months, then two for four more.
